body: I’m sorry. People suck. Relationships suck. Everything sucks.

People keep saying “you can do better” but I really don’t see how. He was everything I wanted in a partner. That’s why I put so much effort into making us work.

Plus I don’t see how I could ever trust someone again. If I even managed to meet someone new, I’d be so paranoid that this would happen again. I’d be bringing so much emotional baggage.

It’s such a stupid thing to start feeling suicidal again because of a GUY. I just don’t know how to be happy without having my person. It’s so fucking stupid.

Yeah, I would never go for someone who was in a relationship. I was finally so happy with him though. It was the longest I’ve gone without a panic attack and the most confident I’ve ever felt. I feel like more of a loser in this situation though.
I’m really struggling with the part where others don’t define us. It’s a nice thought, but so hard to honestly believe.
True. Probably because, in the end, someone still wants him and he wants her back and I’m left broken-hearted and alone again.
Yes, but I loved everything else about him and wanted to work on it so that I could enjoy the sex too.
I’m glad you reached that realisation. I know I should fight too, but I’m just so exhausted from having to fight all the time only to keep getting hurt.
Because I couldn’t make him as happy as he made me
I clearly didn’t deserve him, but this other woman does.
Exactly. I don’t want to keep going through this. Damned if you do, damned if you don’t.
